scientific_integrity: Exact conditional-mean theorem supported by an analytic two-regime proof; numerical verification supplements rather than substitutes for it. The computation and formulas have undergone same-model review only, not independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Only two predetermined exact sign measurements of a standard Brownian bridge; a scalar signed integral with squared loss. Adjustable thresholds, arbitrary binary encoders, adaptive sites, noise, more bits and broader Gaussian processes are not covered. Historical priority remains provisional.
title: Unique globally optimal two sign-only sites for Brownian-bridge integral quadrature
